system.description:
Requirements: Wind Style Dedication, Training (3) and Expertise (3) in Melee Weapons or Ranged Weapons, 5 abilities with the Wind Style trait, and you must receive training from a master of this style, or have access to their teachings

Cost: 3 Focus

Range: Self

You give yourself to the wind for a single breath, and it carries you through all of them.

As an Action, spend 3 Focus. You may Fly up to double your Stride or Fly Speed, whichever is higher. This movement may pass through enemies' spaces without a check (it cannot end in an occupied space), and does not trigger attacks or effects that respond to your movement.

During this movement, make one attack against each of up to three different enemies. Each target must be within the attack's Range from the space you occupy when you make the attack against it. You do not have Disadvantage for making a Ranged attack against a target within 1 space.

You may end Zephyr Style after you perform this ability to impose Disadvantage on all attacks against you until the start of your next turn. If you do, you may not enter Zephyr Stance again until the start of your next turn.
